title: How Tall Is Cabo Girão, and Is It One of Europe's Highest Sea Cliffs?
description: Cabo Girão is about 580 metres high. It ranks among Europe's tallest sea cliffs, but not first: cliffs in Norway, the Faroes, Ireland and Spain are higher.
heroAlt: The 580 metre Cabo Girão cliff seen from sea level, with two people at the bow looking up
keywords: is Cabo Girão the highest cliff in Europe

images.prompt: Realistic photograph taken from the bow of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, low angle looking up at the Cabo Girão cliff in Madeira in clear morning light. Two small figures seen from behind at the bow, heads tilted up. The layered volcanic face in red, brown and dark grey fills most of the frame, with vertical darker dykes, green scrub on ledges and the tiny glass skywalk notch at the very top. Deep blue water at the bottom edge, natural colours, no faces, no text.
images.alt: The 580 metre Cabo Girão cliff seen from sea level, with two people at the bow looking up
